selection: the placeholder views of the table and the calculator editor
description: The table editor and the calculator editor as placeholder views with a title and a phrase selector, the table editor also with the related columns of each column tier, so that the steps of docs/table_creation.md can link to them before the editors are done. This file is imported as the last step of the db setup, so that no database id of a tested view or component moves.

words.name: numeric ascending
words.description: sort condition: by the number of the column, the smallest number on top

words.name: alpha ascending
words.description: sort condition: by the text of the column, from a to z

words.name: alpha descending
words.description: sort condition: by the text of the column, from z to a

words.name: alpha parent ascending
words.description: sort condition: by the text of the parent in the column, from a to z

words.name: alpha parent descending
words.description: sort condition: by the text of the parent in the column, from z to a

triples.name: table column
triples.description: list: the items of a triple from a phrase to this keyword are the own columns of the table of the phrase in their order, instead of the columns of all tables

triples.name: table sort
triples.description: list: the items of a triple from a phrase to this keyword are the own default sort orders of the table of the phrase, each a triple of the condition word with the verb of and the column e.g. numeric descending of reward ratio

triples.name: table parameter (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of a table; the groups are on its to side, so that the phrase data of a page that uses a word such as export does not walk to them

triples.name: table column (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the columns of a table; the column tiers mayor, main and minor are the children of column (system)

triples.name: all table column (system)
triples.description: Flag: show every phrase that has a value for at least one row.

triples.name: level table column (system)
triples.description: Which level is currently active: major / main / minor / all.

triples.name: order table column (system)
triples.description: Explicit sort order of the columns, independent of the level.

triples.name: order rule table column (system)
triples.description: Rule used when no explicit order is given: alphabetical, by value count, by last change, by relevance.

triples.name: groups table column (system)
triples.description: Columns grouped under a shared header (e.g. all years under “Revenue”).

triples.name: frozen table column (system)
triples.description: Number of leading columns that stay fixed when scrolling horizontally.

triples.name: width table column (system)
triples.description: Fixed, auto or min/max width per column.

triples.name: hidden user table column (system)
triples.description: Columns the user has explicitly hidden, overriding the level.

triples.name: pivot phrase table column (system)
triples.description: The phrase whose related phrases become the columns (e.g. “year” → 2024, 2025 …).

triples.name: row (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the rows of a table

triples.name: phrase row (system)
triples.description: The phrase whose related phrases define the rows (e.g. “sector of revenue”).

triples.name: verb row (system)
triples.description: The verb used to find the related phrases (“is a”, “is part of”, “has”).

triples.name: direction row (system)
triples.description: Whether the row phrase is the subject or the object of the triple.

triples.name: filter row (system)
triples.description: Additional conditions a row must satisfy (value range, has source, time range).

triples.name: order row (system)
triples.description: Sort column and direction; may be a list for multi-level sort.

triples.name: order rule row (system)
triples.description: Default sort when nothing is chosen: alphabetical, by first value column, by hierarchy position.

triples.name: limit row (system)
triples.description: Maximum number of rows shown before paging kicks in.

triples.name: page size row (system)
triples.description: Rows per page when paging is on.

triples.name: page row (system)
triples.description: The page currently shown.

triples.name: show all row (system)
triples.description: Flag: ignore the limit and show all rows (with paging).

triples.name: frozen row (system)
triples.description: Number of header/total rows that stay fixed when scrolling vertically.

triples.name: pinned row (system)
triples.description: Rows the user wants to keep at the top regardless of sort.

triples.name: hidden user row (system)
triples.description: Rows the user has explicitly removed from the view.

triples.name: empty row (system)
triples.description: Show, hide or grey out rows that have no value in any visible column.

triples.name: hierarchy (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the sub-rows of a table

triples.name: verb hierarchy (system)
triples.description: The verb that defines sub-rows (“is part of”).

triples.name: expand hierarchy (system)
triples.description: Default state of sub-rows: collapsed, expanded, expanded to level n.

triples.name: max depth hierarchy (system)
triples.description: How many levels of sub-rows may be opened.

triples.name: indent hierarchy (system)
triples.description: Visual indent per level (or tree lines, or a separate “level” column).

triples.name: parent value hierarchy (system)
triples.description: How the parent row’s value is shown: own value, sum of children, both, or blank.

triples.name: orphans hierarchy (system)
triples.description: Where to put rows that have no parent: top, bottom, hidden.

triples.name: multi parent hierarchy (system)
triples.description: A phrase can be part of several phrases: show it under each, under the first, or once with a marker.

triples.name: sort scope hierarchy (system)
triples.description: Sorting applies within siblings only or flattens the tree.

triples.name: value (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the values shown in a table

triples.name: type value (system)
triples.description: Expected type per column: number, text, date, boolean, link, phrase.

triples.name: format value (system)
triples.description: Number format: decimals, thousands separator, percent, scientific.

triples.name: unit value (system)
triples.description: Unit shown (in header or in cell) and target unit for conversion.

triples.name: scale value (system)
triples.description: Scale factor for display (thousands, millions).

triples.name: time value (system)
triples.description: Which point in time or period the value refers to (latest, specific year, average).

triples.name: source mode value (system)
triples.description: Which value wins when several sources exist: preferred source, latest, average, user’s own.

triples.name: show source value (system)
triples.description: Show the source inline, as tooltip, as a separate column, or not at all.

triples.name: show confidence value (system)
triples.description: Show measured / assumed flag and confidence number.

triples.name: missing value (system)
triples.description: What to display for an empty cell: blank, “n/a”, dash, estimate.

triples.name: align value (system)
triples.description: Left, right, centre per column type.

triples.name: truncate value (system)
triples.description: Max text length before truncation with tooltip.

triples.name: conditional style value (system)
triples.description: Rules for colour, bold or icon depending on the value (thresholds, deltas).

triples.name: delta value (system)
triples.description: Show the change against a reference (previous period, other source) as absolute or percent.

triples.name: editable value (system)
triples.description: Whether the user may enter a value directly in the cell.

triples.name: unmatched values value (system)
triples.description: Flag: show the values that fit to no column or no row, which are hidden by default.

triples.name: aggregation (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the totals of a table

triples.name: totals row aggregation (system)
triples.description: Show a total row: sum, average, count, none.

triples.name: totals column aggregation (system)
triples.description: Show a total column across the visible columns.

triples.name: subtotals aggregation (system)
triples.description: Subtotals per hierarchy level or per group.

triples.name: function aggregation (system)
triples.description: Function per column when rows are collapsed: sum, avg, min, max, last.

triples.name: scope aggregation (system)
triples.description: Whether totals cover visible rows only or all rows including paged ones.

triples.name: header (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the headers of a table

triples.name: label header (system)
triples.description: Short label vs. full phrase name per column.

triples.name: rotate header (system)
triples.description: Rotate header text to save width.

triples.name: show unit header (system)
triples.description: Unit in the header instead of the cell.

triples.name: tooltip header (system)
triples.description: Show the phrase description on hover.

triples.name: row label mode header (system)
triples.description: Row label as phrase name, abbreviation, id, or with description.

triples.name: layout (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the layout of a table

triples.name: title layout (system)
triples.description: Table title (defaults to the row phrase and value phrase).

triples.name: caption layout (system)
triples.description: Explanatory text under the table.

triples.name: density layout (system)
triples.description: Compact, normal, comfortable row height.

triples.name: striped layout (system)
triples.description: Alternating row background.

triples.name: borders layout (system)
triples.description: None, horizontal, full grid.

triples.name: transpose layout (system)
triples.description: Swap rows and columns.

triples.name: max width layout (system)
triples.description: Table width in px, percent, or fit-to-content.

triples.name: responsive mode layout (system)
triples.description: On small screens: horizontal scroll, stack columns, drop minor columns first.

triples.name: background layout (system)
triples.description: Flag: show the grey background of the design, which is hidden by default.

triples.name: design layout (system)
triples.description: The name of the table design of config.yaml that overwrites the default design for this table.

triples.name: interaction (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the interaction of the user with a table

triples.name: sortable interaction (system)
triples.description: Whether the user can click headers to sort.

triples.name: filterable interaction (system)
triples.description: Per-column filter boxes.

triples.name: searchable interaction (system)
triples.description: Free-text search over the visible table.

triples.name: selectable interaction (system)
triples.description: Rows can be selected (single / multi) for further actions.

triples.name: drilldown interaction (system)
triples.description: Clicking a row or cell opens the phrase, the value history, or a sub-table.

triples.name: reorderable interaction (system)
triples.description: User may drag columns or rows.

triples.name: resizable interaction (system)
triples.description: User may change column widths.

triples.name: refresh mode interaction (system)
triples.description: Static, reload on demand, live update.

triples.name: context (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the context of a table

triples.name: view owner context (system)
triples.description: The user or group that defined this view (for sharing).

triples.name: view shared context (system)
triples.description: Whether other users may reuse the definition.

triples.name: language context (system)
triples.description: Language for phrase names and formats.

triples.name: profile context (system)
triples.description: Which user profile / estimation set the values come from.

triples.name: time reference context (system)
triples.description: Global “as of” date for all values.

triples.name: export (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the export of a table

triples.name: formats export (system)
triples.description: Allowed exports: CSV, JSON, Markdown, PDF, image.

triples.name: scope export (system)
triples.description: Visible cells only, or all rows/columns, or including hidden sources.

triples.name: include sources export (system)
triples.description: Attach the source list to the export.

triples.name: state (system)
triples.description: keyword for the parameters of the state of a table

triples.name: persist user changes state (system)
triples.description: Remember the user’s column/row choices between sessions.

triples.name: reset to default state (system)
triples.description: Allow the user to return to the defined view.

triples.name: view version state (system)
triples.description: Version of the definition, so changes to the view can be traced like values.

components.name: system title table editor
components.description: show the language specific title of the table editor

components.name: system title calculation editor
components.description: show the language specific title of the calculation editor

components.name: phrase selector
components.description: placeholder to select the word or triple that an editor starts from

components.name: column tiers
components.description: the columns of each column tier that are related to the phrase of the table

components.name: table editor table
components.description: the table of the phrase of the table editor with the columns that the column tiers above define

components.name: button show editor phrase
components.description: the form of the phrase selector that shows the editor again for the selected word or triple

components.name: calculator editor
components.description: the editor of the calculator page of the phrase with its own phrase selector, built by a script from the phrase data of the phrase

views.name: Table editor
views.description: placeholder to define the columns, the rows and the default sorting of a table starting from a word or triple

views.name: Calculator editor
views.description: the editor to define the calculator page of a word or triple

view_relations.description: the edit menu of the table offers the table editor with the same phrase
